selection_query:
WITH mr AS (
  SELECT * FROM index WHERE collection_id='ea1141' AND Modality='MR'
), mg AS (
  SELECT * FROM index WHERE collection_id='ea1141' AND Modality='MG'
)
SELECT
  mr.PatientID,
  mr.SeriesInstanceUID AS mr_uid,
  mr.SeriesDescription AS mr_description,
  mr.instanceCount AS mr_instances,
  mr.series_size_MB AS mr_size_mb,
  mg.SeriesInstanceUID AS mg_uid,
  mg.SeriesDescription AS mg_description,
  mg.instanceCount AS mg_instances,
  mg.series_size_MB AS mg_size_mb,
  mr.instanceCount + mg.instanceCount AS total_instances,
  mr.series_size_MB + mg.series_size_MB AS total_size_mb,
  mr.source_DOI,
  mr.license_short_name
FROM mr JOIN mg USING(PatientID)
WHERE mr.instanceCount + mg.instanceCount BETWEEN 32 AND 400
  AND mr.series_size_MB + mg.series_size_MB <= 180
ORDER BY mr.PatientID, mr.SeriesInstanceUID, mg.SeriesInstanceUID
LIMIT 1
